On [[Abeloth's planet]], there was a '''cave''' where the entity [[Abeloth]] resided, on the side of a volcano.<ref name=":0">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], a strike team sent by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] landed on Abeloth's planet while in search of [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]].<ref name=":0" /> Later, [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] arrived at the planet with the Sith [[Vestara Khai]] with her father [[Gavar Khai]] and [[Sarasu Taalon]]. They searched the cave while there.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>
